Game Overview

At its heart, Mountain Bike Xtreme is a racing game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Mountain Bike Xtreme keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Mountain Bike Xtreme?

Mountain Bike Xtreme is a free racing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Mountain Bike Xtreme free to play?

Yes, Mountain Bike Xtreme is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
